output.revised_prompt: Create isolated production title artwork for a premium mobile slot game. Render the exact text "GEM CLASSIC" exactly once, in one centered horizontal line. The title must be the only subject. Use bold, highly legible vintage casino uppercase lettering designed to read clearly at mobile size: cream enamel letter faces, dimensional rose-gold and polished pale-chrome bevels, deep burgundy side depth, and restrained small ruby-red and emerald-green pin lights integrated into the letterforms. Warm classic slot-marquee illumination and lively nostalgic gambling-floor excitement, while keeping all lighting contained within the title itself. Wide centered composition with generous clean margins. No surrounding plaque, border, frame, symbols, or decorative objects. Background must be perfectly flat, solid, uniform chroma-key magenta #FF00FF edge to edge, with no gradient, texture, noise, vignette, shadow, reflection, haze, bloom, or glow touching/spilling onto the background. No magenta anywhere in the lettering. Crisp clean silhouette for chroma extraction. No extra text, no logo, no watermark. Avoid neon cyberpunk styling, fruit, candy, script lettering, thin letters, and black background.
